Alternatives to NVIDIA Instant Replay? (With HDR Support)
I have this constant issue of Instant Replay turning itself off, I even installed software like [Always Shadow](https://github.com/Verpous/AlwaysShadow) just for it to work correctly, but it's still issues on issues.

I am searching for an alternative which can do 5 minute 60fps/1440p videos with **HDR support and ability to upload to YouTube**.  
I've tried [Steelseries Moments](https://steelseries.com/gg/moments) but they kinda suck at it and can just record videos in SDR with a Watermark...

I've heard people using [medal.tv](http://medal.tv), with HDR capture being in early access.

So what is your opinion? Personally I would not be against using [Steelseries Moments](https://steelseries.com/gg/moments) if there is HDR support that I can enable, but if there's not, **what platform or software do you recommend**?
